WB03.reason: A fresh-sandbox state restore needs a state, and the candidate cannot save one: p6_state_save refuses with 'COPR: the strobe of the Copper is out of range' because the accessors of the Copper, beam, DMAL, scheduler and blitter state (patches 0094, 0095, 0078, 0097/0098/0100/0103) read internals that 6100b17 rewrote and were only adapted to compile (0903..0907), not to be complete. Not run rather than run on an incomplete state; tasks UPD-state-* proposed. The candidate guest does build, pass the import audit and run 60 units in a real Waterbox sandbox with the picture hash of the native build.

WB04.reason: Same reason as WB03 (no candidate state to restore, rewind or seek). Snapshots of the pin are not loaded by the new layout and are not promised to be: the envelope identity (guest, config, series hash) differs and the bodies changed size (CHSL 245 -> 191 bytes).

differences_against_the_pin.evidence: cross-version.json: over the 28 scenarios and every boundary, master ticks, the PCM the host receives and every chipset digest (copper, blitter, beam, denise, agnus, paula) are bit-identical to the pin.

756x574 -> 752x574 on OCS (headless dump of a500-lores-bars): pixels are identical from column 4 on in 572 of 574 rows, the left blank edge and 4 columns on the right change; the 2 other rows differ. b17: horizontal centering and relaxed automatic scaling. ECS/AGA scenarios keep 756 columns and the same 572 rows. The two rows are not explained.
a500-hires-lace-fields: only 317 of 574 rows equal after the edge shift. b17 'remove interlace artifacts' is a candidate cause; not checked.

headless A1000: the pin shows 756x574 in every unit; the candidate delivers no picture in unit 13 and then 752x576. b17: 'A1000 (No EHB) chipset option incorrectly selected OCS Agnus'. Inside Waterbox the guest prints the hash of the stale buffer for a unit with video=0 where the native adapter prints 0 (port-adaptation, task UPD-wbx-frame-hash).

audio-modulated-pal (unit 1) and ocs-hires-lace-ntsc (unit 2): only the CIA digest differs there. b17 moved CIA-A/CIA-B TOD counting to the v6 hsync/vsync check routines (custom.cpp, conflict of patch 0028). Not bisected.

13 of 28 scenarios have a different CPU digest at unit 1 (all four AGA ones, four of the five A600 ones, five of the 19 A500 ones). The 12 scenarios where CPU, RAM and CIA are equal include the CPU-only, halt, audio-tone, keyboard, pot, reset, swap-disk, floppy-write and blitter ones. RAM differs in 3 of them by 4 to 7 bytes: the stack byte of the interrupted loop (0x3ff 0x16 -> 0x18) and the JOY0DAT words the VERTB handler logs. The chipset digests are equal, so what differs is when the CPU sees the vertical-blank interrupt or the input counters. Hypothesis: the new vblank/bitplane arbitration phase (b13/b14/b16); not bisected. Reproducer: cross_version.py or onecase on ocs-lores-bars-pal, digest cpu at unit 1.

digest.scheduler differs at unit 0 in every scenario (133 -> 125 bytes: the scheduler accessor carries firstvent2idx+1 instead of event2idx and no blitter slot), and digest.input/digest.video follow from the CPU phase and the picture geometry. They compare the accessor layouts, not the machine.

14 tests/host modules fail on the candidate: test_cfgfile_defaults (extracted default_prefs needs gfx_keep_aspect_seen), test_cia_keyboard (INT_MAX vs MAXINT in the pinned source), test_cpu_rom_guard (clear_events link), test_custom_cia and test_savestate_source (probe aborts), test_custom_timing (compute_vsynctime no longer called from compute_framesync), test_custom_vsync (nosignal_trigger assert: new no-signal logic), test_devices (blitter_hsync), test_drawing_source (34 vs 30 includes), test_drawing_sync (extracted harness), test_events (secondary queue: new MISC_handler), test_m68k_flags (pinned hash), test_memory_rom_status and test_rom_load_chain (is_builtin_aros_rom in the harness).

The candidate cannot save a state (see WB03). Layout changes already visible: CHSL 245 -> 191 bytes (3 RGA slots, upstream PR #526), 12 BEAM words, 7 COPR words and 2 GEOM words are read as zero, the scheduler word idx becomes firstvent2idx+1 and event2max is a new unsaved variable.
